headline: Enel Green Power partnership announcement signals continued momentum on Sentry expansion and performance analytics

signals.summary: Enel Green Power published a dedicated article highlighting joint work with Raptor Maps to increase solar energy efficiency. Public partnership visibility and case-study credibility.
signals.suggestedAction: Confirm the scope and timeline of the partnership story with William Badnaruk; propose a formal case study or co-marketing asset (webinar, whitepaper) featuring the Texas 181 MWdc drone-in-a-box pilot and efficiency gains. Use it to build awareness of Sentry across Enel's broader fleet.

headline: Enel North America completes 911 MW GulfStar mega-project; 556 MW solar co-location signals operational portfolio growth requiring baseline Raptor Solar/Inspections onboarding and Sentry expansion planning

signals.summary: Enel North America completed GulfStar, a 911 MW hybrid solar and storage project—Enel's largest US power plant. This represents material portfolio growth requiring Raptor Solar baseline deployment to cover the new MW under management.
signals.suggestedAction: Contact William Badnaruk to confirm GulfStar's onboarding timeline to Raptor Solar. Offer a commissioning and baseline RS Inspections plan (aerial thermography + visual) for the 911 MW site to ensure warranty documentation and performance establishment at COD.

signals.summary: Enel completed a 556 MW solar array co-located with an operational 355 MW battery energy storage system. The hybrid asset presents an opportunity to expand RS Inspections and Sentry to cover both solar and battery plant health monitoring.
signals.suggestedAction: Clarify with Enel whether this 556 MW site is distinct from GulfStar or part of it. If separate, ensure it is on the Raptor Solar roadmap and propose RS Inspections and Sentry for the hybrid asset (solar + BESS) to capture performance and risk data across both equipment classes.

headline: Enel Green Power signs $1B agreement to acquire 830 MW US wind and solar portfolio, with major renewables capex plan acceleration.

signals.summary: Enel Green Power has signed an agreement to acquire 830 MW of operating US wind and solar capacity for ~$1 billion, as part of a broader $63 billion renewables investment plan through 2026. This material acquisition of operating assets (majority solar by Enel's portfolio mix) will significantly expand the MW under management on Raptor Solar and create onboarding opportunities for the new sites.
signals.suggestedAction: Contact William Badnaruk and Enel North America's Asset Management team this week to: (1) Confirm the solar MW breakdown of the 830 MW acquisition and expected close date; (2) schedule an onboarding kickoff for the new sites to Raptor Solar, including baseline RS Inspections scope; (3) identify which sites are candidates for RS Sentry expansion (especially if any are large/utility-scale with high automation potential); (4) assess whether the new portfolio includes any NERC-registered facilities to open Raptor Comply discussion.

headline: Enel Green Power acquires 270 MW operational US solar portfolio across three states—material MW addition for Raptor Solar and Sentry expansion

signals.summary: Enel Green Power acquired 270 MW of operational solar PV across seven farms in three new US states for $140M. This is material growth to their North American fleet and a direct onboarding opportunity for Raptor Solar (if not already on platform) and baseline RS Inspections; also a strong candidate for Sentry expansion, aligning with William Badnaruk's vision of drone-in-a-box deployment across the portfolio.
signals.suggestedAction: Contact William Badnaruk this week to confirm: (1) Which of the seven acquired sites are already on Raptor Solar and which require onboarding; (2) Whether they plan to baseline-inspect the new acquisitions with RS Inspections (with thermal, structural, and construction QA data for asset health baseline); (3) Whether Sentry drone-dock deployment is planned for any of the new sites as part of their 'faster issue discovery' operational roadmap.

headline: Enel acquires 625 MW US solar portfolio in September 2026; material expansion play for Raptor Solar, Sentry, and Inspections across North America

signals.summary: Enel acquired a 625 MW US solar portfolio (Faraday and Skyhawk solar plants, plus additional assets) for $760M in September 2026. This is a material expansion of Enel North America's MW under management and directly adds utility-scale sites requiring performance monitoring, digital twin setup, and baseline inspections.
signals.suggestedAction: Contact William Badnaruk or his team in Enel North America Asset Management this week to confirm the portfolio acquisition close date, site locations (particularly if Texas-based), and planned onboarding timeline to Raptor Solar. Offer to conduct a rapid digital-twin setup and baseline inspection plan for the new sites, flagging any performance baselines already available from the prior operator. Then propose a phased RS Sentry rollout for the new sites (flagging the DJI restrictions and Raptor Maps' hardware-agnostic path) and a baseline RS Inspections pass within 60-90 days of close to document as-acquired condition.

headline: Enel Green Power acquires 270 MW operating US solar portfolio—material expansion of North American fleet under Raptor Maps management

signals.summary: Enel closed acquisition of an operating 270 MW US solar portfolio for ~$140 million in early October 2026. This is a material addition to Enel North America's fleet already under Raptor Maps management. The portfolio is operating (not greenfield), which means immediate onboarding to Raptor Solar baseline coverage and RS Inspections baseline.
signals.suggestedAction: Contact William Badnaruk and Enel's North America asset management team this week to confirm: (1) which states and specific sites comprise the 270 MW portfolio; (2) current O&M provider and baseline inspection cadence; (3) timeline for onboarding these plants to Raptor Solar and establishing baseline RS Inspections coverage. Position Raptor Solar as the unified performance-intelligence platform for the expanded fleet, and propose a phased inspection plan (initial baseline visual + thermal across all sites, then risk-based cadence). Confirm MW and site counts for platform scaling.
